policy.name: original-projected-trained-qk-persistent-attention-v1
policy.source: Unchanged WP13 original-hidden BF16 projection centers/radii, all1024 selected rows; WP14 trained RMS/RoPE interval arithmetic at these newly frozen positions. No device observation sets a source bound.
policy.cache: Keep prior rotated K intervals/nominals and original projected V intervals/nominals for the current request. Reset only on a new request generation, never on contractionID.
policy.dot: Outward sum256 of interval endpoint products, plus gamma512*sum(max_absolute_products)+512*2^-126. FP32 to BF16 RNE; FP32 scale1/16 then BF16 RNE.
policy.shift: s_i-max_j(s_j)=min_j(s_i-s_j), with the self term exactly0. Bound each other difference, take endpoint minima, enclose FP32 rounding, and use known nonpositivity. Refuse any shift enclosure below-24.
policy.exp: Monotone exp endpoints with2^-44 FP64 relative allowance and qualified2^-20 device relative error on[-24,0]. Structural exp(0)=1 from the unchanged polynomial.
policy.probability: Positive exp sum with gamma_n and FTZ error, positive reciprocal with2^-20 relative error, FP32 exp*inverse, independent BF16 RNE.
policy.value: Outward interval products of each BF16 probability and uncertain cached projected V; gamma_(2n) magnitude/FTZ reduction bound, then BF16 RNE.
policy.gate: Monotone ideal sigmoid over the original projected gate interval, FP64 relative2^-44 and unchanged qualified FP32 sigmoid relative2^-18 covering exp/denominator/division. Original gate interval must prove-abs(g) in[-24,0]. BF16 sigmoid then FP32 product and BF16 output.
policy.correlations: Unknown shared-input/weight/cache correlations are discarded conservatively. Only the exact self-score difference and structural zero are retained. All binary64 endpoint arithmetic rounds outward.
policy.nominal: Ideal binary64 arithmetic on source BF16 nominals, BF16 at each model boundary; diagnostic comparison only, never used to tighten intervals.
policy.limits: Fixed four-case CPU sequence and proposed first two connected tokens of one selected head; no upstream hidden RMS, all heads/GQA/output projection/full layer/model/hardware qualification.
